_README: This is a copy-paste template for adding a project to the carousel.
The live data lives in index.html, in the `const PROJECTS = [ ... ]` array
near the bottom of the file (search for 'PROJECTS —').
1. Copy the `project` object below (everything inside the braces).
2. Paste it into the PROJECTS array in index.html, between two existing
entries or at the end. Separate entries with a comma.
3. Replace the text. Delete this _README key — it is not read by the page.
4. Save. The pill, the slide and the counter all generate themselves.
ORDER: projects appear in array order. Move a block to reorder it.
REMOVE: delete a whole block. One project is fine; the arrows just wrap.
SPECIAL CHARACTERS: this is JSON inside JavaScript, so:
- use < and > instead of < and >   e.g. "<1 day", ">600%"
- do not add your own quote marks to `quote` — the page adds them

project.title: The project headline — one sentence, no full stop
project.quote: A pull-quote describing the value delivered. Renders in quotation marks automatically.
project.summary: One paragraph of context: what the client needed, what EconLab built or analysed, and the scale of it. Three or four sentences reads best.
points: First thing delivered — a concrete capability or output
Add or remove lines freely; four to six reads best

metrics.label: What this number counts — keep the label to one line or two
Use the HTML entities for angle brackets
Two or four metrics look best; odd numbers leave a gap

steps.label: STAGE NAME IN CAPS
steps.title: Short bold line describing what happened at this stage
steps.text: One or two sentences of detail. What was done, and why it mattered.

steps.label: FOURTH STAGE
steps.title: Short bold line
steps.text: Detail sentence. The last step has no connector line beneath it.
